function: p. 6-8: IGCN-based beamformer maps imperfect CSI to the BS digital precoder (DBF) and the RHS amplitude (HoBF), minimizing transmit power under per-vehicle rate constraints.
system: p. 4-10: Downlink MISO mmWave at 30 GHz; BS with RHS (16 feeds, 64 elements) serves single-antenna vehicles; RHS is a BS-side antenna, not a RIS (p. 2).
method: p. 7-10: Incremental GCN (IGCN) beamformer, label-free loss (transmit power plus rate penalty), trained task by task by fine-tuning with knowledge replay and weight consolidation (lifelong learning).
data_channel: p. 5, 10: Own simulator, no public data: time-varying Saleh-Valenzuela mmWave channel with Jakes-model outdated CSI; 1 km two-lane road, 5000 samples per scenario.
test_conditions: p. 11, 14: Trained on 16, 14, ..., 2 vehicles in sequence; tested on 3-15 and 18-50 vehicles and under Gipps, Krauss, IDM mobility; speeds 5-30 m/s.
baselines: p. 12-15: Non-learned: phased arrays, MRT with outdated CSI. Learned: EWC, iCaRL, transfer learning (approximation ratio); PPO-based DRL (training episodes and latency only).
metrics: p. 13-15: BS transmit power, approximation ratio against single-scenario retraining, training episodes to convergence, inference latency.
complexity: p. 10: Stated complexity O(B s^2 C^2) for s vehicles, B blocks, feature width C; p. 16: inference latency below 80 microseconds.
q1_support: p. 5: "a time-varying Saleh-Valenzuela scattering model is considered to characterize the mmWave channels"; custom simulator with own path-loss and shadowing parameters (Table II, p. 10); 3GPP TR 38.901 appears only as reference [43] (p. 17), with no statement that the simulator is built on it.
q2_support: p. 14: "the trained model is transferred to more congested cases with 18 to 50 MVs"; training used only 2 to 16 vehicles (p. 14).
q3_support: Non-learned: p. 15: "ratio transmission (MRT) method" (non-robust MRT with outdated CSI, transmit power); learned: p. 13: "elastic weight consolidation (EWC), incremental classifier and representation learning" plus transfer learning, on the approximation ratio (Figs. 11-12).
q4_support: p. 10: "The computational complexity of the feature embedding is" (order given, overall O(B s^2 C^2)); p. 16: "achieves microsecond-level inference" (below 80 microseconds).
q5_support: p. 10: "The simulated IoV network consists of a 1 km bidirectional" road segment of the authors' own simulator; no code or data link and no public dataset anywhere in the paper.
notes: RHS is a BS-integrated metamaterial antenna that the paper says is totally different from a RIS (p. 2, footnote 1), so ris=0. q1: TR 38.901 is cited at [43] with three other sources for the Saleh-Valenzuela model, not stated as the simulator basis. q3: EWC, iCaRL and TL are generic continual-learning methods applied to the same beamforming problem, the reviewer should confirm; the PPO DRL comparison (p. 15) is on training episodes and latency only.
